notes:
New: Sender rules. Decide what happens with email from a person or a whole company: never suggest a reply, always flag it for you, mark it urgent, or reply in a formal or casual tone. Your old 'never reply to' list has been moved into the rules.

New: Conversation-aware replies (optional). Tick 'Read earlier messages in the conversation' under Settings > Replying and the AI also sees the earlier messages in the thread.

New: Faster or Smarter AI. Choose the AI that suits your PC under Settings > AI, and use Test speed to see how long a reply takes.
